tasks.instruction: Create a clean studio illustration on a white background containing exactly three objects: a blue square on the left, a red circle in the center, and a yellow triangle on the right. The circle must be slightly larger than the other two shapes, and none of the shapes may overlap.

Design a minimal vertical event poster. The exact headline must read 'NIGHT GARDEN'. Put the headline in the upper third, a small illustrated crescent moon centered below it, and the exact text 'FRIDAY 9 PM' on one line at the bottom. Use a dark botanical visual theme with strong legibility.

Create a fictional vintage travel poster for a place called 'Solmere Botanical Coast'. Show terraced glasshouses above a calm turquoise bay, with warm late-afternoon light and simplified screen-printed shapes. Include the destination name once, clearly legible, and do not include any real-world logos or landmarks.

Create a premium editorial product photograph of an unbranded matte stainless-steel reusable water bottle standing upright on a pale stone pedestal. Add one folded linen cloth and a small sprig of rosemary beside it. Use soft side lighting, a neutral beige background, and no visible text or logos.

Create a cozy illustrated menu-board scene for a fictional cafe called 'Juniper Cup'. The board must show exactly three drink names: 'Espresso', 'Cocoa', and 'Mint Tea'. Place a small cup icon beside Espresso, a cocoa bean icon beside Cocoa, and a mint leaf icon beside Mint Tea. Keep all three names readable, use no prices, and show a warm cafe counter in the background without any other text.
